content.title: -ing 分词作定语速查
content.intro: -ing 分词作定语表'主动 / 正在进行':被修饰的名词主动发出这个动作。单个分词放名词前(the rising sun),带宾语或状语的分词短语放名词后(the road leading to town = the road that leads to town)。

headers: 用法 · 例句 · 等价
rows: running water 流动的水;the changing seasons 变化的季节
the road leading to town = the road that leads to town
an exciting journey 令人兴奋的旅程(旅程让人兴奋)
an excited tourist 兴奋的游客(游客感到兴奋)

specialRules.rule: 名词主动发出动作 / 正在进行 → 用 -ing
分词带宾语或状语时,要放到名词之后
specialRules.rule_alt: the man standing there = who is standing there

specialRules.mark: an amazing view / an amazed visitor

specialRules.rule: -ing 表主动,-ed 表被动/完成,别混

why: -ing 分词等于一个主动的定语从句:the boy reading a book = the boy who is reading a book;名词与动作是主动关系,所以用 -ing 而不是 -ed。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空 / 短文改错高频:看名词与动词是主动(-ing)还是被动(-ed)。
情绪类形容词:修饰'事/物'用 -ing,修饰'人/感受'用 -ed(exciting/excited, boring/bored)。
分词短语后置 = 省略'关系代词 + be'的定语从句:the train coming from Beijing = which is coming…

examVsReal.exam: the road leading to the town（考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: the road that goes to town
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考分词后置;口语常直接用定语从句或介词短语

examVsReal.real: a trip that was really fun / so much fun
examVsReal.note: 考试卡 -ing/-ed;口语里常换成 fun、great 等更口语的说法
